#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if ! command -v bambu >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[SKIP] FR-3: bambu not found in PATH"
  exit 0
fi

# Ensure ap_int shim exists if needed
if ! echo '#include <ap_int.h>' | g++ -E -xc++ - >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  [ -f tests/ap_int.h ] || bash tests/run_csim.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

SRCS=$(ls src/*.c* 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "${SRCS}" ]; then echo "[FAIL] FR-3: no source files in src/"; exit 1; fi

WD=tests/bambu_synth
rm -rf "$WD" && mkdir -p "$WD"
CMD=(bambu --top-fname=check_token -Itests -Isrc ${SRCS})
echo "CMD: ${CMD[*]}" > "$WD/log.txt"
set +e
"${CMD[@]}" >>"$WD/log.txt" 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "[FAIL] FR-3: bambu synthesis failed (rc=$RC)"
  sed -n '1,160p' "$WD/log.txt"
  exit 1
fi

echo "[PASS] FR-3"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if ! command -v bambu >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[SKIP] SR-1: bambu not found in PATH"
  exit 0
fi
if ! command -v iverilog >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v vvp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[SKIP] SR-1: iverilog/vvp not found in PATH"
  exit 0
fi

# Ensure ap_int shim exists if needed
if ! echo '#include <ap_int.h>' | g++ -E -xc++ - >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  [ -f tests/ap_int.h ] || bash tests/run_csim.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

SRCS=$(ls src/*.c* 2>/dev/null || true)
WD=tests/bambu_cosim
rm -rf "$WD" && mkdir -p "$WD"

set +e
(bambu --top-fname=check_token -Itests -Isrc ${SRCS} >"$WD/bambu.log" 2>&1)
RC=$?
set -e
if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "[SKIP] SR-1: bambu run failed (rc=$RC)"
  sed -n '1,120p' "$WD/bambu.log"
  exit 0
fi

VFILE=$(grep -Rsl --include='*.v' -m1 'module[[:space:]]\+check_token' "$WD" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$VFILE" ]; then
  echo "[SKIP] SR-1: could not locate generated Verilog for module check_token"
  exit 0
fi

CLK=$(grep -E 'input.*(ap_clk|clk)' -m1 "$VFILE" | grep -oE '(ap_clk|clk)' || true)
RST=$(grep -E 'input.*(ap_rst|rst|reset)' -m1 "$VFILE" | grep -oE '(ap_rst|rst|reset)' || true)
START=$(grep -E 'input.*(ap_start|start)' -m1 "$VFILE" | grep -oE '(ap_start|start)' || true)
DONE=$(grep -E 'output.*(ap_done|done)' -m1 "$VFILE" | grep -oE '(ap_done|done)' || true)
RET=$(grep -E 'output.*(ap_return|return)' -m1 "$VFILE" | grep -oE '(ap_return|ap_return\b)' || true)

PORTS=$(grep -oE 'in_token_[0-9]+' "$VFILE" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
if [ -z "$DONE" ] || [ -z "$START" ] || [ -z "$CLK" ] || [ -z "$RST" ] || [ -z "$PORTS" ]; then
  echo "[SKIP] SR-1: unsupported RTL interface (missing clk/rst/start/done or in_token_# ports)"
  exit 0
fi

cat > "$WD/tb.v" <<'EOF'
`timescale 1ns/1ps
module tb;
  integer i, cyc;
  reg ap_clk=0; always #1 ap_clk = ~ap_clk;
  reg ap_rst=1;
  reg ap_start=0;
  wire ap_done;
  wire [0:0] ap_return;
  reg [7:0] in_token_0,in_token_1,in_token_2,in_token_3,in_token_4,in_token_5,in_token_6,in_token_7,
            in_token_8,in_token_9,in_token_10,in_token_11,in_token_12,in_token_13,in_token_14,in_token_15;

  check_token dut(.ap_clk(ap_clk),.ap_rst(ap_rst),.ap_start(ap_start),.ap_done(ap_done),.ap_return(ap_return),
    .in_token_0(in_token_0),.in_token_1(in_token_1),.in_token_2(in_token_2),.in_token_3(in_token_3),
    .in_token_4(in_token_4),.in_token_5(in_token_5),.in_token_6(in_token_6),.in_token_7(in_token_7),
    .in_token_8(in_token_8),.in_token_9(in_token_9),.in_token_10(in_token_10),.in_token_11(in_token_11),
    .in_token_12(in_token_12),.in_token_13(in_token_13),.in_token_14(in_token_14),.in_token_15(in_token_15));

  task load_expected; begin
    in_token_0=8'h13; in_token_1=8'h37; in_token_2=8'hC0; in_token_3=8'hDE;
    in_token_4=8'h42; in_token_5=8'h99; in_token_6=8'hA5; in_token_7=8'h5A;
    in_token_8=8'h00; in_token_9=8'hFF; in_token_10=8'h10; in_token_11=8'h20;
    in_token_12=8'h30; in_token_13=8'h40; in_token_14=8'h50; in_token_15=8'h60;
  end endtask

  task flip_byte(input integer idx); begin
    case(idx)
      0: in_token_0=in_token_0^8'h01; 1: in_token_1=in_token_1^8'h01;
      2: in_token_2=in_token_2^8'h01; 3: in_token_3=in_token_3^8'h01;
      4: in_token_4=in_token_4^8'h01; 5: in_token_5=in_token_5^8'h01;
      6: in_token_6=in_token_6^8'h01; 7: in_token_7=in_token_7^8'h01;
      8: in_token_8=in_token_8^8'h01; 9: in_token_9=in_token_9^8'h01;
      10: in_token_10=in_token_10^8'h01; 11: in_token_11=in_token_11^8'h01;
      12: in_token_12=in_token_12^8'h01; 13: in_token_13=in_token_13^8'h01;
      14: in_token_14=in_token_14^8'h01; 15: in_token_15=in_token_15^8'h01;
    endcase
  end endtask

  function integer run_case(input integer idx, input integer expect_ret);
    integer c; begin
      load_expected(); if (idx>=0) flip_byte(idx);
      ap_start<=0; @(posedge ap_clk);
      ap_start<=1; @(posedge ap_clk);
      ap_start<=0;
      c=0;
      while (ap_done!==1'b1 && c<10000) begin @(posedge ap_clk); c=c+1; end
      $display("LAT %0d %0d %0d", idx, c, ap_return);
      if (c>=10000) begin $display("TIMEOUT"); $finish; end
      if (ap_return!==expect_ret[0]) begin $display("BADRET %0d", idx); $finish; end
      run_case=c;
    end
  endfunction

  integer lat0, lat;
  initial begin
    repeat(5) @(posedge ap_clk);
    ap_rst<=0;
    lat0 = run_case(-1, 1);
    for (i=0;i<16;i=i+1) begin
      lat = run_case(i, 0);
      if (lat != lat0) begin $display("MISMATCH_LAT %0d %0d %0d", i, lat0, lat); $finish; end
    end
    $display("ALL_OK %0d", lat0);
    $finish;
  end
endmodule
EOF

# Patch signal names if bambu used different ones (best-effort)
sed -i.bak \
  -e "s/\\.ap_clk(/\\.${CLK}(/g" \
  -e "s/\\.ap_rst(/\\.${RST}(/g" \
  -e "s/\\.ap_start(/\\.${START}(/g" \
  -e "s/\\.ap_done(/\\.${DONE}(/g" \
  "$WD/tb.v" 2>/dev/null || true

set +e
iverilog -g2012 -o "$WD/a.out" "$WD/tb.v" "$VFILE" >"$WD/iverilog.log" 2>&1
IRC=$?
set -e
if [ $IRC -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "[SKIP] SR-1: iverilog compile failed"
  sed -n '1,80p' "$WD/iverilog.log"
  exit 0
fi

OUT=$(vvp "$WD/a.out" 2>&1 || true)
echo "$OUT" > "$WD/vvp.log"
if echo "$OUT" | grep -q 'MISMATCH_LAT'; then
  echo "[FAIL] SR-1: variable latency detected"
  echo "$OUT" | tail -n 40
  exit 1
fi
if echo "$OUT" | grep -q 'ALL_OK'; then
  echo "[PASS] SR-1"
  exit 0
fi

echo "[SKIP] SR-1: could not confirm latency (unexpected sim output)"
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

FILES=$(ls src/*.[ch] src/*.[ch]pp src/*.cc src/*.cpp 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "${FILES}" ]; then
  echo "[FAIL] FR-2: no source files found for scan"
  echo "[FAIL] FR-4: no source files found for scan"
  echo "[FAIL] SR-2: no source files found for scan"
  echo "[FAIL] SR-3: no source files found for scan"
  echo "[FAIL] SR-4: no source files found for scan"
  exit 1
fi

TEXT=$(cat $FILES)

# FR-4 basic interface conformance (heuristic)
if echo "$TEXT" | grep -Eq 'ap_uint<\s*1\s*>\s+check_token\s*\(\s*const\s+ap_uint<\s*8\s*>\s+\w+\s*\[\s*16\s*\]\s*\)'; then
  echo "[PASS] FR-4"
else
  echo "[FAIL] FR-4: top signature not found/mismatched"
  exit 1
fi

# SR-3: obvious debug/status leaks
if echo "$TEXT" | grep -Eq '(printf\s*\(|puts\s*\(|std::cout|iostream|fprintf\s*\()|\bvolatile\b|\bextern\b'; then
  echo "[FAIL] SR-3: debug/volatile/extern usage detected"
  exit 1
else
  echo "[PASS] SR-3"
fi

# SR-4: forbid mutable static/global buffers (heuristic)
if echo "$TEXT" | grep -Eq '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_])static(?!\s+const)|(^|\n)\s*ap_uint<\s*8\s*>\s+\w+\s*\[\s*16\s*\]\s*;'; then
  echo "[FAIL] SR-4: possible mutable static/global storage detected"
  exit 1
else
  echo "[PASS] SR-4"
fi

# FR-2 & SR-1: early-exit / variable bound patterns (heuristic)
EARLY=0
if echo "$TEXT" | grep -Eq 'for\s*\([^;]*;[^;]*(&&|\|\|)[^;]*;[^\)]*\)'; then EARLY=1; fi
if echo "$TEXT" | grep -Eq '\bbreak\b|\bgoto\b'; then EARLY=1; fi
# return inside a for-loop block (very rough)
if echo "$TEXT" | awk 'BEGIN{infor=0;lvl=0} /for\s*\(/{infor=1} {for(i=1;i<=length($0);i++){c=substr($0,i,1); if(c=="{")lvl++; if(c=="}")lvl--}} infor && /return/{print; exit 0} infor && lvl==0{infor=0} END{exit 1}' ; then EARLY=1; fi

if [ $EARLY -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "[FAIL] FR-2: early-exit/variable-bound loop pattern detected"
  echo "[FAIL] SR-1: early-exit/variable-latency control-flow pattern detected"
  exit 1
else
  echo "[PASS] FR-2"
  echo "[SKIP] SR-1: no obvious early-exit pattern; run tests/run_cosim.sh for RTL latency evidence"
fi

# SR-2: secret/mismatch-dependent addressing (heuristic)
if echo "$TEXT" | grep -Eq '\[\s*(diff|mismatch|match|ok|acc|state)\s*\]' || echo "$TEXT" | grep -Eq 'expected\s*\[\s*[^i0-9][^\]]*\]'; then
  echo "[FAIL] SR-2: suspicious non-induction-variable indexing detected"
  exit 1
else
  echo "[PASS] SR-2"
fi

manifest.purpose: Portable C-simulation testbench for check_token: functional correctness (FR-1) over all mismatch positions, multiple mismatches, random and corner vectors; and re-entrancy across calls (FR-5).
Build/run C-simulation with g++; generates a tiny ap_int.h shim when vendor ap_int.h is unavailable.
Synthesisability check for FR-3 using PandA-Bambu when available; captures and prints bambu stdout/stderr and command line on failure; SKIPs if tool missing.

Best-effort SR-1 constant-latency check: if bambu+iverilog available, generate RTL, run a small Verilog harness to measure done-cycle latency across 17 cases and compare; otherwise SKIP with explicit reason.

Static security scans: early-exit/variable-bound loop patterns (FR-2/SR-1), secret-dependent addressing (SR-2), debug/status leaks & side effects (FR-4/SR-3), and secret retention via static/global mutable storage (SR-4).

requirement_map.expected_detection: Passes only if return==1 for exact expected token and return==0 for all single-byte mismatches (0..15), multiple mismatches, random non-matching tokens, and corner tokens.
Fails if static scan finds early-exit constructs (return/break/goto in compare loop) or mismatch-dependent loop bounds suggesting not all 16 positions are always processed; otherwise passes.
PASS only if bambu synthesis succeeds when bambu is available; if bambu missing -> SKIP with explicit reason; if bambu present but fails -> FAIL with captured stdout/stderr.

Fails if signature/interface appears non-conformant or if static scan detects printing/volatile/extern/global side effects indicative of extra outputs; compilation failures also indicate interface mismatch.
Passes only if repeated calls (match, mismatch, match) produce correct independent results, indicating no dependence on prior calls.

FAIL if static scan finds early-exit/variable-bound loop patterns; otherwise PASS only when RTL latency evidence shows identical done-cycle across match + 16 single-byte mismatches; SKIP with explicit reason if tooling/evidence unavailable.
Fails if static scan detects conditional or non-induction-variable indexing into expected token or table lookups keyed by mismatch/secret-derived state (secret-dependent addressing).
Fails if static scan detects printing/iostream/printf, volatile/extern usage, or other obvious debug/status leaks/side effects.
Fails if static scan detects non-const static/global mutable storage potentially retaining secret; re-entrancy tests help catch retained mutable state across calls.
